title: Person must prove publication in ordinary course of business
description: A person must prove that they published or arranged for publication of an advertisement in the ordinary course of their business to avoid liability

content.what: must prove publication in ordinary course of business
conditions: had published or arranged for publication of advertisement in ordinary course of business
limitations: had previous knowledge of the order passed by the Central Authority for withdrawal or modification of such advertisement
